papers.title: Weak-field multi-collector benchmark
papers.hypothesis: A frozen local-flow policy has a finite grid-censored positive matched first-interception boundary under the primary uniform-field condition.
papers.kill_criterion: Stop or narrow if the oracle cannot exploit the field, exact counterfactual matching fails, or passive and swept-area controls explain the effect.
papers.open_blocker: The primary policy is four independent replicas and fails the AAMAS multi-agent gate; passive/random controls descriptively match or exceed it; timestep convergence and an independent confirmatory protocol remain unresolved. Growing geometry is not primary-ready.

papers.title: Inactive placeholder
papers.kill_criterion: No second paper may activate without a genuinely separable question and Program Director decision.

primary_question: Under the frozen canonical uniform-drift task and scripted local_flow_v1, which preregistered rho is the first grid point at which mean matched horizon-censored first-interception improvement has a strictly positive one-sided simultaneous 95% lower confidence bound?
exploratory_result: SPS-P02 has no positive simultaneous LCB through rho=2.0; this cannot update SPS-C01 because calibration seeds were used.

engineering_tests.scope: simulation primitives, exact specular continuous contact, event-keyed ties, deterministic reset, causal local observations, matched runner, immutable schema-validated artifacts, scripted policies, inference, and limiting cases

fresh_review.strongest_new_threat: The provisional 0.05 simultaneous half-width is coarser than observed effects near 0.004--0.011, so a 24-seed confirmation would be structurally uninformative.
